body:
**Tier:** DECISION. Split from #674 via PR #1024 (the zero-row case is pre-existing and was pinned, not changed, there).

**Mechanism.** `df_data_grabber` raises `KeyError('No table ...')` for an org table that is declared (`#+name:` present) but has 0 data rows. `get_categorical_mapping`'s rung loop catches `(FileNotFoundError, KeyError)` as "this level lacks the table". So an empty wave- or country-level table is indistinguishable from an absent one, and resolution continues to the next level, including the cross-country level appended by #953. The caller gets the global (or country) table with no signal, although the local level *declared* the name. `code_label_map` inherits this.

**Why it matters.** The #953 rule is that a local level overrides the shared table *whole-table*. An author who empties a local table (e.g. to disable a mapping, or by a botched edit that leaves only the header) gets the shared table instead, silently. That is the same "silent resolution" class as #674.

**Evidence.** Pinned by `tests/test_categorical_mapping_value_required.py::test_zero_row_table_is_a_separate_case` (PR #1024): with a value column, an empty local table raises `KeyError` when nothing lower holds it, i.e. it is treated as absent. No corpus census of empty declared tables has been run.

**Options (decision needed).**
- (a) An empty declared table raises a distinct error, e.g. `EmptyCategoricalTableError`, which the rung loop does not catch.
- (b) An empty declared table resolves to an empty mapping at that level and stops the cascade.
- (c) Keep the fall-through but warn.

A census of `#+name:` tables with 0 rows across `countries/**/categorical_mapping*` should come first, so the cost of (a) is known. Related: #953, #928.

comments.body:
**Ruling (@ligon, 2026-10-18)**, from the framework-backlog decision sheet: Census first (`#+name:` tables with 0 data rows across `countries/**/categorical_mapping*`), then option (a): an empty declared table raises a distinct error the rung loop does not catch. Silent fall-through is the #674 class.

Scheduled for the overnight 2026-10-18 sweep.

title: categorical-mapping cascade: a declared-but-EMPTY org table silently falls through to a lower level
